variety_description: A high yielding Zinc enriched medium maturity, medium tall, long bold variety suitable for high and medium highlands in southern Bangladesh. Biofortified Zinc variety was developed by BRRI with support from Harvest Plus. Released in 2014 for planting under rainfed lowland growing conditions in Aman season. Strong plant type, lodging tolerant. High grain weight.
